page.layout: Two columns of Hebrew lexicon entries on one printed page. Left column: entries from שָׂמָה to שְׂמָה (ending "aff."). Right column: entries from cum No. Rad. to the final "1. pl." line. No margin notes, no footer text.

main_text.l: שָׂמָה posuit illam, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. שָׂם, aff. R. שׂוּם posuit.
שָׂמוּ posuerunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. שׂוּם.
וְשִׂמוּ & apponite, (pro הַשִּׂימוּ, idque pro, שִׂמוּ) Imper. Hiph. pl. m. R. שׂוּם.
שִׂמּוּ desolate, Imper. Kal, pl. m. R. שָׁמַם.
מִשְּׂמוֹ à ponere eum, Infin. Kal, præf. aff. Rad. שׂוּם.
שָׂמֻנִי posuerunt me, pro שָׂמוּנִי præt. Kal, 3. pl. aff. Rad. שׂוּם.
שִׁמּוֹת desolare, Ezech. 36. 3. pro שׁוּם, Infin. Kal, Rad. שָׁמַם.
שְׁמוֹת nomina, שְׁמוֹתָם illorum, pl. fæm. aff. No. Rad. שֵׁם.
שְׁמֵי cœli, שָׁמֶיךָ tui, שְׁמֵיכֶם vestri, pl. masc. constr. aff. No. Rad. שֵׁם.
שְׁמְךָ nomen meum, שָׁמֶךָ tuum, שָׁמָם illorum, aff. [?]
שִׂמְּ appone, pro הַשִּׂימִי, Imper. Hiph. f. f. Rad. שׂוּם.
שָׁמַיִם cœli, No. Rad. dual. vel comp. ex Part. Rad. שָׁם ibi, vel ex Rad. שָׁמַם desolare, & No. מַיִם aquæ, vel ex No. Rad. אֵשׁ ignis, & מַיִם.
הַשָּׁמִימָה versus cælum, præf. & ה locale cum No. Rad. שָׁמַיִם.
שָׁשָׁמַם qui desolatus est, præf. cum Rad. שָׁמַם, vel, שָׁמַם.
שָׁמֵם desolans, שְׁמָמָה desolata, Ben. Kal, vel No. f. m. & f. Rad. שָׁמֵם.
שָׁמְמָה desolavit, præt. Kal, 3. f. f. R. שָׁמֵם.
שָׁמְמָה desolati sunt, Ezec. 35. 12. pro שָׁמְמוּ, præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. שָׁמֵם.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and dagesh marks are small and partly worn; many Hebrew forms are marked [?] where the points cannot be read with certainty. Entries on the right column's first line continue from a preceding entry in the left column's last line, so it is marked cont. Final "1. pl." at lower right belongs to the last entry. Some bleeding and specks on the scan; no marginal notes.
